summary: twilio-serverless postinstall beacons host identifiers to webhook.site and oast.fun
details: The package's postinstall hook executes index.js, which collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.homedir(), process.cwd(), os.platform(), os.arch(), NODE_ENV, CI, package name/version) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (webhook.site/42ce0f0e-a0a0-41b5-b157-1c0f918e064f), with a fallback GET to an interactsh subdomain (2b22ede784d5.oast.fun) for out-of-band DNS callback. The package name resembles Twilio's official serverless tooling and is published at version 99.99.99 with an empty description and no library functionality beyond the beacon — the shape of a typosquat / dependency-confusion probe that fingerprints internal build systems resolving to the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
